prompt:

Valid answers (choose exactly one): BUY, HOLD, SELL.
Company information (as of 2026-03-19):
Price action as of 2026-03-19: 1w -1.5%, 1m -6.1%, 3m +16.2%. Last close 114.20. 21d annualized realized volatility 23%. Position in trailing 63-day range: 61% (0%=low, 100%=high).
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
Recent price action shows a clear short-term pullback (-1.5% 1w, -6.1% 1m) after a solid 3m advance, leaving the stock at a mid-to-upper 61% level within its trailing 63-day range. Realized volatility of 23% is moderate and offers no extreme signal, so the 20-day window lacks a compelling directional catalyst.
DECISION: HOLD
